lead_html:
Owner 2026-10-16: “the flexible hose seems absolutely enormous when attached to things like pumps … The pump needs to be made to be commensurate with such a thick tube. And we might need to shrink the tube diameter a bit … anything the hoses can connect to (pumps, tanks, reels) as well as when you place a tank, reel, or pump next to each other some kind of connection should be visually apparent … The pipe needs connectors that show where it's connecting.”

Numbers. Hose today: 0.38 cell flat / 0.465 plump. Rigid pipe: 0.23. Pump today: 1 x 1 cell. Proposed: hose 0.65x = 0.25 flat / 0.30 plump (still a little thicker than the pipe); pump footprint 2 x 1, drawn 2 x 2 (about 1.9 x 1.1 cells of machine), its two port flanges sized to the 0.30 hose.

Rows. Pump, flange and saddle, one row per look (A = the only candidate; pick it, or note what to change). Then one mockup per join type, each column a look: top half today, bottom half proposed (pipe arm running to the tank or pump edge plus a flange; a flange pair where a pump or reel touches a tank; a saddle where a hose couples onto a pipe). Nothing is installed; the hose stays at today's width and the fittings stay switched off until you rule. Design note: design/RimMandrake/liquid_connections_visuals_2026-10-16.md.
